title: The Design system panel lists the design systems its door applies while the gallery's design-systems switch is off (production's state), and its cards are not dimmed under Coming soon
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/design-system-library-door.test.mjs — tracy-web's GET /api/design-system/library offers every gate-passing Refero system to a signed-in seat; read apps/tracy-web/src/sites/design-system-library-doors.js (no gallery switch read), packages/design/tracy-design-inspiration/src/client/useDesignSystemSources.ts and DesignSystemTab.tsx (the tab lists fetchLibrary's rows, not the gallery catalog), and the committed lib/client.js. Until feat/design-system-ui (12/10/2026) the panel read the gallery catalog with ?systems=all; the library is now Refero-only and served by tracy-web, so S1 guards that read instead.

S2: node --test test/gallery.test.mjs test/routes.test.mjs test/design-system-library.test.mjs (cwd packages/design/tracy-design-inspiration) — the catalog door on a fake Tracy answering {shown:false}: without a query no design system; parseRoute maps only systems=all.
S3: import systemOf from src/client/design-system-library.mjs and build a row from {platforms: []}; read src/client/DesignSystemGrid.tsx.
expect: S1: the library door test 'library: every Refero system that passes the gate, nothing else, in one shape' and the signed-out refusal pass; the door's code reads no design-systems/ui switch; useSystemLibrary calls fetchLibrary(), DesignSystemTab uses useSystemLibrary() and no longer calls fetchCatalog(; the committed lib/client.js carries '/api/design-system/library'.

S2: GET …/catalog (no query) still lists no design system while the switch is off and a silent Tracy is off; parseRoute returns { kind: 'catalog' } for any other value of systems; fetchLibrary keeps only Refero rows.
S3: systemOf returns a row without a platforms key, and the panel grid has no Coming soon badge, so no card is drawn dimmed under Coming soon.

selectors.page: src/client/design-system-library.mjs fetchLibrary, systemOf; src/client/useDesignSystemSources.ts useSystemLibrary; src/client/DesignSystemTab.tsx; src/client/DesignSystemGrid.tsx

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-walkthrough-2026-10-11/README.md — A-wordpress/bug1-panel-empty-before-fix.png (before), A-wordpress/10-panel-open.png (after), 11/10/2026 on the local stand rebuilt from feat/ds-walkthrough.
fence: The gallery switch itself (/ops › Design templates) is not pressed here: the gallery door is driven by a fake Tracy answering both values, and the library door by fakes of the offered list and the sign-in check. The panel on a real dsh page is in the evidence (taken before the Refero-only library).
